senses.gloss: (Assyr. nadanu, v. Fried. Del. Proleg. p. 139; v. נְדוּנְיָא) to give; to place; (neut. verb) to be given.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 10:3:3">Y. Snh. X, 29ᵇ</cite> bot. (ref. to <he>לא יָדוֹן</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 6:3">Gen. VI, 3</cite>) <he>לא יִדּוֹן … שאיני נותן רוחי וכ׳</he> my spirit shall not be given to him, (which means) I shall not put my spirit into them &c. (at the time of the resurrection); Bab.
